text: 财政部部长蓝佛安《求是》撰文，财政是国家治理的基础和重要支柱。财政政策作为宏观调控的重要手段，具有扩大总需求和定向调结构的双重优势。“十四五”以来，我国财政政策始终保持积极取向，并根据形势变化适时调整完善，不断增强与经济运行的适配性，有力支撑了经济平稳健康发展。今年以来，面对国内外复杂环境带来的困难挑战，财政部门坚决落实党中央和国务院决策部署，牢牢把握高质量发展这个首要任务，扎实实施更加积极的财政政策，着力稳就业、稳企业、稳市场、稳预期，着力推改革、强管理、防风险、增效益，促进经济实现质的有效提升和量的合理增长。
text_en: Finance Minister Lan Fo'an wrote in Qiushi that finance is the foundation and an important pillar of national governance. As an important means of macroeconomic regulation, fiscal policy has the dual advantages of expanding aggregate demand and targeted structural adjustment. Since the 14th Five-Year Plan, China's fiscal policy has consistently maintained a proactive orientation and been adjusted and improved in light of changing conditions, continuously enhancing its compatibility with economic operations and strongly supporting steady and healthy economic development. Since the beginning of this year, facing difficulties and challenges brought by the complex domestic and international environment, the finance department has resolutely implemented the decisions and arrangements of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, firmly grasped the primary task of high-quality development, solidly implemented a more proactive fiscal policy, focused on stabilizing employment, enterprises, markets and expectations, and focused on advancing reform, strengthening management, preventing risks and increasing efficiency, promoting both qualitative improvement and reasonable quantitative growth of the economy.
